subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should maintainers accept this stacked publisher-follow UI/API slice before the base follow-graph API PR is proven and landed?
rationale: The branch depends on a conflicting open base PR that introduces private follow state and a public API contract, so final acceptance depends on maintainer product/API ownership plus contributor proof rather than a mechanical repair alone.

options.title: Land the base API first
options.body: Require the base publisher-follow API PR to clear proof, public contract, and generated artifact blockers before rebasing and reviewing this UI/discovery slice.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review the API, controls, and notification stack as one feature, accepting the larger private-state boundary in one pass.

options.title: Pause this follow-up
options.body: If the follow-graph API direction is not accepted, keep this follow-up draft paused or close it rather than carrying a conflicting stacked branch.

recommendation.title: Land the base API first
recommendation.body: Require the base publisher-follow API PR to clear proof, public contract, and generated artifact blockers before rebasing and reviewing this UI/discovery slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Blame ties the current route/API package and publisher UI baselines to this person, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate.
